# PublishRank SEO for WordPress
> PublishRank SEO 2.26.0 is a free, open-source WordPress SEO plugin for businesses, stores, service providers, creators, publishers and websites of every kind. It includes site metadata, connected schema, XML and News sitemaps, Local SEO, WooCommerce SEO, redirects, 404 monitoring, analytics, Traffic Guard, Access Shield, Schema Studio, SEO Inspector and optional editorial workflows. Schema Studio provides templates for 246 catalogued Schema.org types, and Local SEO supports up to 50 locations. The supplied 2.26.0 reports document local testing on WordPress 7.1.5, PHP 8.4 and SQLite; they identify untested environments and paths. SEO metadata and structured data do not guarantee rankings or rich results.
